name: Havath Prime
description: Havath Prime was the fourth planet in the Muunilinst system, a part of the Obtrexta sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was a gas giant orbited by thirty-two moons, itself circling the star Muunilinst. The entirety of the Muunilinst system was located along the hyperlane known as the Braxant Run.
